feed.title: Shizuku Apps Directory — New Apps
feed.subtitle: Newly discovered Android apps that use Shizuku

entry.title: cyb3rl00m/prune-debloater
entry.summary: An opensource tool for Android devices to debloat and optimize them. Enhancing speed and privacy.

entry.title: Santoshkurmi/antigem
entry.summary: A mobile IDE wrapping antigravity cli, opencode , codex and claude cli to provide a full Android coding environment. Features an advanced code editor, integrated AI chat, built-in Git client, and full Termux terminal access for on-the-go development.

entry.title: DurchEins/apkup
entry.summary: Modern open-source Material 3 Android APK updater & actively maintained APKUpdater successor. Supports Google Play, F-Droid & IzzyOnDroid (Index V2), APKMirror, GitHub, GitLab & Codeberg with signature verification, Watchlist, Obtainium sync & silent Shizuku/Root.

entry.title: NNazuna/nna-clicker
entry.summary: Touch recorder & auto clicker for Android. Record taps and swipes, replay them with precise timing. No root, no internet, no trackers.

entry.title: neveSZ/onehz
entry.summary: Refresh-rate controller for Samsung and Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO displays via Shizuku. No root, no accessibility service. Tested on Galaxy S25+ and POCO X7 Pro.

entry.title: ezn24/DroidCar
entry.summary: DroidCar allows Android phones to connect to CarPlay Head-unit, just like an iPhone, without root.

entry.title: uenzuwkxos/BloodMoon
entry.summary: An Android app designed to combat blue light and eye strain. Compatible with Android TVs.

entry.title: wuy489934-svg/DLA
entry.summary: DLA · DeepSeek LLM Agent：跑在你自己 Android 手机上的本地智能体（非官方，非官方产品）。Agent 通过 Shizuku 或 Termux 二选一执行真机任务，工具按需发现、默认逐次审批、无遥测，模型请求直达你自己的端点。

entry.title: onerdna/stalker
entry.summary: Save data viewer & editor for Shadow Fight 2

entry.summary: High-performance lightweight FPS monitoring overlay inspired by Samsung Perf Z for gaming and performance testing

entry.summary: Glass-box adaptive-brightness replacement with explainable decisions and circadian support.

entry.summary: Syncs files in and out of restricted Android/data folders when target apps open or close

entry.title: tiendnm/zukulock
entry.summary: Very lightweight app that locks the screen when launched. Helps reduce wear on the power button

entry.title: farizanjum/mixer-1
entry.summary: Per-app volume overlay intercepting hardware keys
